The [[Steelhead Scythe]] is a rare type of [[scythe]]. Its head is tri-bladed and attached to a long, straight handle.
[[Image:Steelhead_Scythe_head.jpg|right|thumb|120px|A view of the head of the Steelhead Scythe showing the cage the metal bands form around the head.]]
